observations: Photo 0 shows a blue console wrapped in plastic, with a gold PS4 logo (triangle, circle, cross, square) on top. The console appears to be a custom or special edition, not the standard PS4 Slim.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a slightly different angle, with a custom controller in front. The controller has a blue and grey camouflage pattern.
Photo 2 shows the console from a side angle, with the controller placed on top. The console has a textured blue surface with the same gold PS4 logo.
The console is not the standard PS4 Slim; it appears to be a custom or limited edition model, possibly a 'Blue Customised PS4 Slim' as claimed.
The controller is a custom design, not the standard DualShock 4.
The console is wrapped in plastic, suggesting it is new or unused.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in any photo.

identity.kind: custom PS4 Slim console with custom controller

claims.claim: Blue Customised Ps4 slim with 10 latest games. Such as FIFA and PES 2027 and others.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
